Maya Chen: Heads up — pulling together a quick "account vital signs" for Horizon Health before renewal next week. Need to confirm SLO alignment, final latency graphs, and whether they qualify for onboarding credit.
Jordan Liu: Thanks — what's the ask from CS? a list + evidence? :point_right:
Maya Chen: Yep. I need: 1) rolling 30d uptime %, 2) p95 latency on the /generate route, 3) any incidents affecting their dedicated pool, 4) whether onboarding tasks completed. Prefer links to graphs or short snippets.
Priya Patel: Onboarding status: training + evals done, feature flags set, but they still haven't completed the integration test matrix (item 3). I flagged in Gainsight.
Sam Rodriguez: P95 numbers — pulling from Console dashboards now. Will paste short snippet when ready.
OnboardBot: [alert] Integration test matrix missing for Horizon Health (owner: @Priya Patel).
Sam Rodriguez: p95 for /generate (30d): 182ms avg, p95 460ms. 1 spike on 3797999990 due to region failover — cause: routing fallback to alt cluster.
Jordan Liu: Do they meet the latency SLO? Our SLO is p95 < 500ms in their contract tier.
Maya Chen: So they do. But the failover spike triggered a partial credit event last month — need to check credit window and if we already issued.
Priya Patel: I saw the ledger — no credit issued yet. Ops asked for runbook confirmation.
Sam Rodriguez: Sharing graph: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/horizon/p95-30d
Jordan Liu: Recommend: 1) confirm integration test completion by EOD, 2) send customer-facing note with p95 + uptime + incident summary, 3) if runbook gaps found, offer one-time onboarding credit (up to 10%) and schedule enablement session.
Maya Chen: Draft note: "Hi Horizon — summary: uptime 99.97% (30d), p95 460ms, one failover event on Mar 12 caused latency spike; no credit applied yet, offering 1-1 enablement and optional onboarding credit if integration testing completes by Fri." Anyone want to edit?
Priya Patel: Edit: add link to their test matrix and assigned timeline. Also add contact for the enablement session (Sam).
Sam Rodriguez: I'll run the runbook checklist with eng-oncall tomorrow and copy you.
Maya Chen: Great. I'll send the customer note after Priya confirms the test matrix. Thx all :thumbsup:
